//: Commit guard (PreToolUse/Bash) + PO orchestrator reminder (UserPromptSubmit). Default uses PowerShell (always present on Windows). On macOS/Linux swap the commands to their .js twins, e.g. node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/pre-commit-guard.js"

hooks.command:
node -e "const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const cmd=((p.tool_input||{}).command||'');if(/git\s+push [\s\S]* (main|master) /.test(cmd)){process.stderr.write('[GUARDRAIL] Direct push to main is blocked on this repo.
Create a branch first:
  git checkout -b feature/your-branch
  git push origin feature/your-branch
');process.exit(2);}if(/git\s+commit /.test(cmd)){const{execSync}=require('child_process');try{const b=execSync('git branch --show-current',{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).toString().trim();if(b==='main'||b==='master'){process.stderr.write('[GUARDRAIL] Committing directly on main is blocked on this repo.
Create a branch first:
  git checkout -b feature/your-branch
');process.exit(2);}}catch{}}process.exit(0);"
